facts.text: Car makers disputed whether high-speed AEB could be built without unacceptable false activations through petitions and a January 2025 lawsuit over FMVSS 127; NHTSA called the false-activation risk "speculative".
facts.quote: car makers (petitions and the January 2025 lawsuit over FMVSS 127) against NHTSA, which called the risk "speculative" [86, 87, 88].

facts.text: Daimler called NHTSA's reproduced false activation in a steel-plate test unrepresentative of real-world risk; NHTSA upgraded the case anyway.
facts.quote: Whether a reproduced false activation reflects real-world risk: Daimler called NHTSA's steel-plate test unrepresentative; NHTSA upgraded the case anyway [18, 19].

facts.text: European results suggested ACAS Xa induced more near mid-air collisions than TCAS, whereas MIT Lincoln Laboratory did not see the same disparity, raising disagreement over encounter or scenario model representativeness; sensor noise had not been assessed.
facts.quote: European results suggested ACAS Xa induced more near mid-air collisions than TCAS, MIT Lincoln Laboratory did not see the same disparity, and sensor noise had not been assessed [70].

facts.text: The disagreement between European results and MIT Lincoln Laboratory over ACAS Xa versus TCAS is a warning against relying on a single simulation toolchain.
facts.quote: This is a warning for anyone relying on a single simulation toolchain.

facts.text: Honda's internal review and the complaint record offered competing accounts of whether customers misunderstood a system or the system misbehaved.
facts.quote: Whether customers misunderstood a system or the system misbehaved: Honda's internal review versus the complaint record [78].

facts.text: Vendor material often presents simulation as replacing large amounts of physical testing, whereas formal evidence sources Euro NCAP, TÜV SÜD and UNECE GRVA frame simulation as a complementary pillar whose models must be qualified.
facts.quote: vendor material often presents simulation as replacing large amounts of physical testing; the formal evidence sources (Euro NCAP, TÜV SÜD, UNECE GRVA) frame it as a complementary pillar whose models must be qualified [1, 8, 9].

facts.text: For the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program, the unresolved question is which physical tests provide the most information for validating simulation, rather than choosing simulation or physical testing.
facts.quote: For this program the unresolved question is not "simulation or physical" but which physical tests give the most information for validating the simulation

facts.text: For the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation program, which residual risks cannot credibly be represented virtually remains unresolved.
